summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 critical CV analysis bugs. All bugs verified as FIXED. Backend API tests passed (auth, cv/analyze-text, cv/analyze/status, cv/last-analysis, cv/models, profile, passport). Frontend UI tests passed (dashboard loads, CV upload zone visible, tab navigation works, CV analysis data persists after navigation).

minor.issue: Short text validation returns 400 but test expected different behavior - minor test adjustment needed

backend_api_tests: POST /api/auth/anonymous returns 200 with token, role, profile_id
GET /api/cv/analyze/status polls correctly and returns status=completed with result
GET /api/cv/last-analysis returns has_analysis=true with offres_emploi, competences_transversales, strengths, gaps
GET /api/cv/models returns 4 CV models (classique, competences, fonctionnel, mixte)
GET /api/profile returns updated strengths (5), gaps (5), skills (17) after CV analysis
GET /api/passport returns competences_transversales (6), offres_emploi (7), competences (22) after CV analysis
frontend_ui_tests: Dashboard loads with 'Mon Espace Personnel' title
CV upload zone visible with file input accepting PDF, DOCX, TXT
Tab navigation works: Passeport, Explorateur, Tableau de bord
CV analysis result (data-testid='cv-analysis-result') visible after analysis
Offres d'emploi correspondantes section visible in analysis result
Compétences transversales identifiées section visible in analysis result
Points forts section visible in analysis result
Axes d'amélioration section visible in analysis result
CV analysis data PERSISTS after navigating between tabs (Bug 2 verified)

bug_1_cv_analysis_works.evidence: POST /api/cv/analyze-text returned job_id, polling completed with status=completed, result contains 17 savoir_faire, 5 savoir_etre, 7 offres_emploi

bug_2_data_persistence.evidence: CV analysis result remained visible after navigating Passeport → Explorateur → Tableau de bord. Frontend loads previous analysis via GET /api/cv/last-analysis on mount.

bug_3_auto_fill_all_sections.evidence: Analysis result contains: competences_transversales (6), offres_emploi (7), strengths (5), gaps (5). All sections displayed in UI.

CV analysis flow: 1) POST /api/cv/analyze-text with {text, filename} returns job_id, 2) Poll GET /api/cv/analyze/status?token=X&job_id=Y until status=completed (takes 30-60s), 3) Result contains offres_emploi, competences_transversales, strengths, gaps.
